scope: First H2 implementation: complete PCM writes, fixed ring backpressure, drain, cancellation handles and zone error propagation. Nonblocking reasoner and unified response ownership remain incomplete.
proven: Large and irregular chunks, including 24000 frames at 24 kHz, retain all producer frames in order with a fixed 3600-frame ring
Device callback consumes partial available data even when callback frame count exceeds ring capacity; software underrun padding is explicit rather than silently dropping source audio
Mono and multichannel frames preserve channel layout; empty streams complete without opening a device and invalid None chunks fail instead of silently truncating
Normal finish waits for the device finished callback; a held device tail cannot be closed early
Buffer stall, device start failure, premature driver termination and drain timeout raise and close owned resources instead of claiming success
Cancelling a full writer or active output wakes the producer, aborts the device and closes the source; external token cancellation during drain cannot become completion
A cancelled producer delivering a late chunk cannot restart or contaminate the next playback generation
Piper and real ZoneManager adapters expose the player before startup, accept a cancellation token, preserve result and propagate errors
Explicit zone routing cannot fall back to another active zone and uses the selected amplifier route/device
Barge-in tests import real Python 3.13 source packages instead of replacing global domain packages/DTOs with historical Python 3.9 stubs
Source-free runtime imports the new player and completes an empty stream without hardware access

checks.chromium: Not repeated; frontend unchanged from the prior effect-expansion record.

dependency_limit: Existing runtime virtualenv read-only with bytecode writes disabled; sounddevice 0.5.5, no dependency upgrades. Runtime/CI dependency reconciliation still belongs to H6.
limits: No real speaker, microphone, amplifier, GPU or model was used; synthetic driver timing is not physical latency or acoustic barge-in validation
Measured cancellation covers player/zone APIs, not the complete main response/capture cancellation graph
ResponseHandler still needs to bind every playback path and session token, including cached and full-array audio
The queued reasoner still consumes a synchronous stream and the router still excludes SLOW_LLM speech; H2 is not complete
Reasoner heartbeat, bounded text streaming, unique response ownership, async transport resource cleanup and audible error integration remain to implement and measure
H0 live home evidence/legacy-memory treatment and H3-H6 remain incomplete; real selection remains disabled
